title: Dova Stash layout or template (dovastash-layout-1)
description: A home's setup: its cell, master and the containers and displays that take item categories (docs/DESIGN.md 6.3, 8.4). The same schema serves templates (Templates/**/*.json) and player layouts (Layouts/*.json). Unknown keys are kept by Dova Stash with a warning; here they are flagged too.

note.description: Free text for people reading the file.

version.description: Semantic version; raise it with every change to a shipped template.

basedOn.description: Player layouts only: "<template source>@<version>" it was made from.

autoDraft.description: An editor auto-draft, refreshed by "Draft all homes"; a template someone made always wins over it.

priority.description: Higher wins between templates of the same cell.

requires.description: Every plugin the file's form references point into (cell, master, containers, their forms, displays, keep forms).

conflicts.description: Plugins that rebuild the home: the template is not offered while one is loaded.

replaces.description: Templates only: retired template sources this one takes over ("Templates/Vanilla/LakeviewManorCellar.json"); an untouched setup made from one of them may be taken in (DESIGN 6.7).

cell.description: The home's main cell: its identity and its layout file name.

cells.description: More cells of a multi-cell home (DESIGN 6.7).

master.description: The area's catch-all while the home's master is out of reach from it.
The container that takes everything without a place of its own.

learned.description: Player layouts only: item -> container the player put it in.

declined.description: Player layouts only: container -> category suggestions the player turned down.

hiddenTemplates.description: Player layouts only: templates the player removed from this home.

formRef.description: "Plugin.esm|0x00ABCDEF": the plugin file and the LOCAL form id (DESIGN 6.1).

categoryPattern.description: A category id ("alchemy.potions"), a group and everything below it ("weapons.*") or "*" (DESIGN 7.3).

forms.description: Items bound to this container one by one.

ignored.description: Listed but never used (respawns, goes away with an upgrade...).

ref.description: The display reference (rack activator, mannequin, plaque, case, bookshelf).

items.description: Preferred items (soft references: skipped when their plugin is not loaded).

set.description: Mannequins: the armor set it wears, by any one of its pieces.

keepEntry.description: "equipped", "favorited", "quest", a form reference or a category pattern.

quota.description: Deposit leaves up to this many on you.

restock.description: Restock also brings you up to the quota (DESIGN 8.7).

keep.description: What Deposit leaves on the player (DESIGN 8.3).
